articles.title: Meta can't stop states' $1.4 trillion lawsuit from going to trial
articles.summary: Meta and TikTok tried to defeat thousands of social media addiction lawsuits in one fell swoop, but an appeals court rejected the attempt in a ruling issued yesterday. First up among the lawsuits is a case brought against Meta by the California attorney general and other state AGs. A trial in district court is scheduled to start on August 19, with jury selection beginning August 12.
